services.desc: Whether you’re interested in a history-related program, a social gathering, or a special event, CCHS sponsors activities throughout the year. Join us! View events and programs sponsored by CCHS and other county historical organizations. Click on 'agenda' in the upper right corner of the calendar grid to access a text listing of events. About: Dennis Webster, curator of the Lucile M. Wright Air Museum in Jamestown, will explore the unique contributions Lucile made to 20th century aviation in Western New York and the work being done by the museum that bears her name.
